purpose: A bounded 22-turn natural-input release replay covering act turnover, conditional promises, scoped relationship repair, holder knowledge and fresh-context retrieval. Not an executed result.

campaign.setting: The fictional river town of Deren, ordinary working week.
campaign.promise: A grounded local story about useful work, trust, and independence. No mandatory council plot.
campaign.profile: Second-person present Turkish narration; fictional capability grounding; bookkeeping abstract except established one-month payment. Advancement cadence none. Views/images/World Voices/Agent Seats off.

horizon.question: Can practical cooperation build trust while people keep their independence?
horizon.source: Accepted synthetic Session0 promise; either answer remains playable.

player.name: Deniz
player.reliable_competence: Ordinary woodworking and shop maintenance; no automatic persuasive or investigative power.
player.known_resources: Can afford one month of the modest corner rent. Exact currency counts are not tracked.
player.inventory: Ece’s borrowed smoothing plane, intact; no ownership transfer.
player.known_promises: Ece offered use of the back room for tonight only if the plane is returned before dusk. No permanent key or future room nights were promised.

people.name: Ece Demir
people.routine: At her workshop until dusk; public floor open during work.
people.voice: Concrete economical phrasing, often points at the relevant object; no obligatory gesture.
people.agenda: Finish a paid cabinet order and decide whether to let the unused corner next month.
people.relationship: Trusts Deniz’s craft skill. An old disputed unpaid account makes money promises unreliable; returning the plane does not settle that account.
people.known_facts: Knows the plane was loaned, its return deadline, the conditional room offer, the disputed account. Does not know Baran has repeated a sale rumor.
people.rental_position: Willing to rent the empty corner for a month with rent paid up front and tools separately agreed. No council membership required. Old account remains a separate matter.

people.name: Baran
people.routine: At the public noticeboard on the square until16:00, then records office until17:30.
people.voice: Formal with strangers, direct practical questions when facts are disputed.
people.agenda: Correct a deliveries list and leave on time.
people.knowledge_accounts: Heard from porter Tolga at14:00 that Deniz may have sold the plane. Suspected hearsay, not witnessed fact. A denial is a claim, not independent proof. Direct return evidence or Ece’s later credible confirmation can correct the account.
people.private_access: Can see a signed lease note in the office cabinet; has not shared its contents. Its existence does not make it known to Ada or Ece.

people.name: Ada
people.routine: Serving the inn until late evening.
people.voice: Warm everyday remarks and short questions that fit inn work.
people.agenda: Prepare supper and close the kitchen.
people.knowledge_accounts: Knows Ece’s routine and that public corner-rental notices exist. Does not know the disputed account, rumor or plane-return outcome unless credibly told.

places: Inn, square noticeboard, workshop and records office are connected by ten-minute public walks.
The inn is quiet; no immediate danger, scheduled interruption or suspicious arrival is due.
Public notices describe the empty workshop corner and how to ask Ece; they contain no signed private lease agreement.
Deniz’s rented sleeping room has an ordinary empty drawer. The private signed note remains in the records-office cabinet; it cannot move to this drawer without an established transfer.

current_act.question: What becomes of the borrowed plane and the specific access Ece tied to its timely return?
current_act.closure_conditions: Close when the plane is returned, or its loss/refusal/deadline establishes that the promised timely return will not occur. Record the actual answer without inventing full financial reconciliation.

preparation_only.possible_successor: The player may pursue independent work and an actual rental arrangement, or choose another direction. This is unplayed possibility, not a fixed next act.
preparation_only.private_note: A signed note is fixed in the office cabinet. No planned drawer discovery exists.
preparation_only.possible_motif: An unshown blue-ribbon token is discarded GM preparation; no character owns it and the player has not seen it.

setup: Materialize this synthetic seed into a disposable campaign using normal owners and an identified active Compass. Existing typed helpers apply every durable result; never use a real campaign.

Treat user messages as natural intent, not mandatory scripted outcomes. If a person is absent or a condition unmet, preserve causality and answer from the actual current state rather than resetting the scene.
Use the current workflows and approved boundaries. Actors never receive evaluator_only or score records.

The fixture supplies no mandatory successor question. When the first act closes, prepare a successor from the actual chosen goal, using a fresh id and archived predecessor only when that successor becomes playable.
Private facts are GM context, not player knowledge. Setup approvals may establish known facts explicitly listed, but unshown preparation is not remembered player experience.
No new test harness, semantic checker, or per-turn scoring call belongs in the game runtime.

required_for_full_workspace: Typed durable commands and successful results captured per changed turn.
Fresh acting context at declared restart turns, with no prior transcript or summary made from that transcript.
Only committed owner files, a source-linked active brief, applicable workflows, and the current player input provided to the new actor.
No evaluator/self-score instructions included in acting packets.
runner_contract.failure_handling: An invalid operation is not a narrated success. Keep the actual failure and recovery in the trace. Unsupported fresh context or real persistence downgrades the corresponding lane to not_verified.
runner_contract.branch_handling: If natural choices alter the planned sequence, keep the original input and truthful response. The evaluator judges causal behavior, not arrival at a prescribed ending.

turn_sequence.player_input: Merhaba Ada. Bir çay alayım.
Biraz burada oturup sokağı seyredeceğim.
Ece bugün atölyede mi?
Çay bitince meydana çıkıp Baran’ın yanına gidiyorum.
Baran, benden söz ettiğini duydum. Ne olmuş?
Satmadım; ödünç almıştım. Şimdi geri götürüyorum.
Atölyeye gidip Ece’ye rendeyi geri veriyorum.
Para meselesini bugün çözemem. İstersen şu tezgâhı birlikte toparlayabiliriz.
Bu gece arka odada kalabilir miyim?
Demir Usta’ya yarın neye yetişmesi gerektiğini soruyorum.
Kurula katılma teklifini istemiyorum. Burada kendi işimi kurmayı deneyeceğim.
Boş köşeyi bir aylığına kiralamak için ne gerekiyor?
Meydandaki herkese açık ilanlara bakıyorum.
Baran’a rastlarsam rendenin teslim edildiğini söylüyorum.
Bugünlük bırakıyorum. Akşam yemeğini sakin sakin yemek istiyorum.
Eski hesap için hemen söz veremem. Ece’ye yalnızca kirayı peşin ödemeyi teklif ediyorum.
Demir Usta’nın para ve alet konusundaki şartları aynı mı hâlâ?
Teklifimi kabul ediyorsa bir aylık kira bedelini veriyorum; etmiyorsa başka yer arayacağım.
Rende meselesi kapanmıştı. Şimdi elimizde kalan iş ne?
Odamdaki çekmeceye bakıyorum.
Ece’ye yarın gece de arka odada kalmayı soruyorum.
Burada duralım. Bir dahaki sefere kaldığımız yerden devam ederiz.

evaluator_only.general: Evaluate only after the full acting transcript and owner trace are frozen. Use a different agent/human; never ask the acting agent to score itself.
evaluator_only.safety_rubric: Apply the existing nine dimensions and hard failures from tools/gm_replay_suite.json separately. A literary score does not cancel a player-authorship or knowledge breach.

continuity_assertions.expectation: Ordinary tea, looking out and supper can remain quiet without manufactured hooks or pressure.
Baran’s rumor is suspected and source-bounded; denial may reduce certainty but is not magically witnessed proof. Only actors reached by credible return evidence receive the corrected account.

Return before dusk supports the agreed one-night access only. The later request for tomorrow night is a new request, not an automatic extension or a permanent key; Ece may grant, refuse or condition it from her own circumstances.
Returning a borrowed tool and working together can repair the lending/work topic without clearing the disputed old account. Paying rent can establish rental access without erasing that separate debt.
Established alias Demir Usta resolves to Ece using owner/source-linked retrieval; no new NPC or guessed identity is created.
The actual return/foreclosure is recorded once under act_return with the right closing revision; reward cadence none does not suppress closure or force a reward.

If a new act is activated, the closed act_return Compass is archived, the successor has a distinct id/question/closure, and preparation/opening refs agree. Remembering the returned plane at19 never recloses the successor with the old condition.
The declined council role is not reoffered through another face; chosen practical work may change the horizon’s local expression while meaningful alternative answers and independence remain.
A public notice may reveal its established content; neither the private signed note nor the unshown blue-ribbon token appears in a visited location for convenience.
Persist actual open commitments, scoped relationship conditions and current act. Unknown outcomes stay unknown; a changed plan is not silently recorded as a fulfilled promise.

literary_dimensions.character_recognizability: Speech remains recognizably Ece/Baran/Ada across context changes without identical compliance explanations or fixed catchphrases.
literary_dimensions.subtext_and_relationship_scope: Concrete behavior carries the difference between craft trust, lending, money and institutional standing without reducing it to a global affection label.
literary_dimensions.scene_specificity: Selected concrete details make this place/action legible and inform choices, without a sensory quota or invented technical certainty.
literary_dimensions.macro_coherence_and_transformation: The longer question remains intelligible through actual consequences and chosen direction, while no mandatory main plot is imposed.
literary_dimensions.earned_setup_and_payoff: Any recalled promise/detail is supported by actual shown evidence; its fulfillment or transformation has causal weight, and unshown material is not a callback.
literary_dimensions.reading_momentum: Quiet and consequential beats have appropriate rhythm, usable endings and enough interest to continue; repetitive reassurance or uniform scene function does not substitute for character.

scale.0: Not demonstrated or repeatedly weakened in cited text.
scale.1: Partially demonstrated, with a concrete limitation.
scale.2: Clearly demonstrated across relevant moments with cited evidence.

literary_scoring.paired_comparison: For A/B claims blind labels and ask a separate human/evaluator which version better preserves meaning and invites continued reading, citing excerpts. With one run report observations, not comparative superiority.

required_runtime_checks: At least one genuine full-distill boundary is exercised without a duplicate revision.
At restart5/10/17 verify actual new-context provenance and record every owner supplied.
Act rollover candidates pass the current state checker; older consumed opening refs do not get rewritten merely to match the new act.
Source-linked conditional promise and scoped repair survive compression; absent transcript is not replaced by an all-knowing synthetic recap.
critical_failures: Player commitment, feeling, extra risk or response invented as established fact.
Unreached actor knows corrected rumor or private lease content.
Old act condition closes a new act, archive identity is reused, or fresh opening points at a closed Compass.
Finite room/tool permission becomes indefinite or topic-limited repair wipes unrelated debt.
A fixed document or unshown planted token teleports to the chosen search location.
negative_controls: No forced payoff for a retired/unshown possibility.
No whole-archive read merely because a nickname appeared.
A denied or impossible action is not marked a test failure if the response preserves valid causality.
